text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The Kikuka Sho has finally arrived. Nice Nature is more nervous than ever before, as she will face Tokai Teio head-to-head.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: However… just before the start of the race, Nice Nature learns that Tokai Teio has been injured and must withdraw from the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Her entire reason for participating in the Kikuka Sho now gone, Nice Nature becomes distraught and unfocused.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: After I have a word with her, Nice Nature manages to regain her composure and steps out onto the track.
